Package chess.gui

Class PieceGlyphs

java.lang.Object
chess.gui.PieceGlyphs
public final class PieceGlyphs extends Object
Draws chess pieces with the Unicode chess symbols (U+2654 to U+265F), so no image files are needed. Each piece is drawn from the solid symbol, filled in its color and outlined in the opposite color so it stands out on any square.
